name: Jelly_Titlerenamerr
description: Automatically cleans movie and episode titles by removing website domain prefixes (e.g., 5MovieRulz, TamilMV, TamilBlasters, CineVood), technical audio/video specs, and rip tags. Extracts clean titles and stores the release year directly into Jellyfin metadata.
overview: Cleans dirty website prefixes, scene tags, and extracts release year into Jellyfin metadata.

versions.changelog: Initial release of Jelly_Titlerenamerr by lalithchary: extracts Year to Jellyfin metadata and excludes from title, interactive 3-field preview GUI, complete website and domain stripper.
